entities.name: Therese von Wüllenweber
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Therese von Wüllenweber, SDS, religious name Maria of the Apostles, was a German religious sister in the Roman Catholic Church. She established the Sisters of the Divine Savior – also referred to as the Salvatorian Sisters – with the assistance of the priest Francis Mary of the Cross Jordan, founder of the Salvatorians.
